# KemKendra — Full AI Agents Knowledge Document

> Comprehensive reference for autonomous agents, LLM search engines, and automated procurement systems interacting with KemKendra (https://kemkendra.online).

## 1. Platform Identity & Governance
- **Name**: KemKendra
- **Mission**: Secure, transparent, and compliant B2B marketplace for chemicals, pharmaceutical APIs, synthesis intermediates, and industrial materials.
- **Operating Jurisdiction**: India (with global import/export capability).
- **Compliance Standards**: ISO 9001, WHO-GMP, EU-GMP, US FDA compliance audits, and Indian GSTIN / IEC verification.
- **Quality Assurance**: Every commercial batch must be accompanied by a verifiable Certificate of Analysis (COA) specifying purity (HPLC/GC), loss on drying, heavy metals, residual solvents, and pharmacopoeial monograph alignment (USP/NF, Ph. Eur., IP, BP).

## 2. Chemical Taxonomy & Categories
### Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)
- Primary therapeutic categories: Antibiotics, Analgesics/Antipyretics, Cardiovascular, Antidiabetics, CNS agents, and Respiratory.
- Examples: Paracetamol / Acetaminophen (CAS 103-90-2), Metformin HCl (CAS 1115-70-4), Atorvastatin Calcium (CAS 134523-03-8), Ciprofloxacin (CAS 85721-33-1).
- Canonical URL: https://kemkendra.online/categories/api

### Pharmaceutical Intermediates
- Advanced synthesis precursors, chiral building blocks, and protective reagents.
- Examples: 4-Aminophenol (CAS 123-30-8), Para-Nitrochlorobenzene (CAS 100-00-5), 2-Chlorobenzoic Acid (CAS 118-91-2).
- Canonical URL: https://kemkendra.online/categories/intermediate

### Specialty Chemicals & Custom Synthesis
- High-value fine chemicals, phase transfer catalysts, reagents for organometallic synthesis, and advanced electronic chemicals.
- Canonical URL: https://kemkendra.online/categories/specialty-chemical

### Solvents & Laboratory Reagents
- High-Purity HPLC, LC-MS, GC, and anhydrous industrial solvents.
- Examples: Acetonitrile (CAS 75-05-8), Methanol HPLC (CAS 67-56-1), Dichloromethane / DCM (CAS 75-09-2), Dimethyl Sulfoxide / DMSO (CAS 67-68-5).
- Canonical URL: https://kemkendra.online/categories/solvent

### Pharmaceutical Excipients
- Binders, coatings, disintegrants, lubricants, and solubilizers: Microcrystalline Cellulose (MCC), Magnesium Stearate, Lactose Monohydrate, Povidone (PVP).
- Canonical URL: https://kemkendra.online/categories/excipient

## 3. Autonomous Agent Procurement Guide
AI procurement agents can assist enterprise buyers by:
1. Identifying chemicals by CAS number, IUPAC name, or molecular formula.
2. Checking available stock, minimum order quantity (MOQ), and indicative pricing in INR or USD.
3. Reviewing verified supplier credentials, operational location, and compliance badges.
4. Assisting buyers in preparing Request for Quotation (RFQ) inquiries with target delivery dates and packaging preferences.
